scene: The creaky gondola rises, carrying a bucket, winch, and napping pigeon.
beats: You crank the winch faster. The gondola surges through a mist bank and lands with a metallic clank beside giant rain barrels on Rainmaker Rooftops.
You stir the glowing foam, releasing a floating iridescent sphere. The cradle bumps against an iron mooring, letting you hop onto the cloud-slicked roof.
The pigeon coos indignantly and drops a brass rooftop key before fluttering up. The gondola stops, allowing you to step onto the rainmaker terrace.
picture: Inside the yellow metal gondola, arranged along one floor from left to right: a brass winch drum, the middle-aged Black man in his burnt-orange jacket, a foaming bucket of blue suds, and a plump pigeon in a knit cap resting on an iron railing. Sky glows purple through the railing bars.
shown: a heavy brass winch with a worn wooden handle on the left
a metal pail frothing with luminescent blue suds in the centre
a plump grey pigeon wearing a tiny knit hat on the right
